# P36.31 — Search index v2 builder (`sig.release-search-index/2`)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/372_P36.31__search-index-v2-builder.md` (manifest row **372**, Round 11 / P36, sub-round 11C; **R11-K13-SRCH-01** — the search index v2 builder).
**Requirement ids satisfied:** **SIG-UI-073** (one search index for all entries), **SIG-UI-074** (one gazetteer), **SIG-SRCH-004** (jurisdiction names resolve first), **SIG-SRCH-005** (acronym handling), **SIG-SRCH-011** (release-verified indexes). Cited: **SIG-UI-039/040**, **SIG-ENG-042**, **SIG-SRCH-007** (derived-name basis shown — carried by `name_basis`).
**Base:** `d11b8926` (the orchestrator's P36.31 dispatch boundary on `r11/P36.79-held-out-search-relevance-set`; P36.79 confirmed green — `ci: pass #392@06b60315`) · **Branch:** `r11/P36.31-search-index-v2-builder` · **PR base:** `r11/P36.79-held-out-search-relevance-set` · **Production mutations (OM-14):** none — exports builder code, a committed data registry and tests; nothing touches the deployment, the spine or a registry flag. **CI config changed:** no.

## What lands

- **`exports/src/exports/search_index_v2.py`** — the v2 builder (replaces, never wraps, the v1 index shape):
  - `search_index_v2.sqlite` per compartment — a compact record index: contentless weighted FTS5 (`porter unicode61 remove_diacritics 2`, bm25 name 10 / place 2 / source 1) over the published label or a **marked** interim derived name (`derived_interim`; K2's `label_basis` rides otherwise), K4 place text (name + country + code), registry source names, entity id, two filter indexes (place, source). The P35.66 public-layer refusal runs before any byte is written.
  - `claim_ref.sqlite` per compartment — `claim BLOB PRIMARY KEY … WITHOUT ROWID` → record_key (UUIDs pack to 16 bytes; ~25 B/claim); `claim_ref_lookup` keeps SIG-FIND-003's exact-claim lookup.
  - `releases/<pub>/search/catalog.sqlite` — ONE catalog for every entry type: places (JUR-01 `sig.jurisdiction-registry/1` when supplied, else the export's `jurisdiction_key_map` interim — the NE gazetteer stays HG-03 gated), registry sources with facet fields, the technology vocabulary (`evidence_signature` synonyms; retired slugs marked), K2 entities as present, K8 documents, dossier pages. Weighted FTS5 + `prefix='2 3'` + trigram table + `exact_names` (official/alternate/identifier/alias bases — SIG-SRCH-004's resolve-first surface; homonyms keep parents).
  - `verify_search_index` — SIG-SRCH-011: streams the file in 1 MiB chunks, hashes it, refuses `integrity_mismatch` / `index_contract` / `release_mismatch` before any `mode=ro` open; `check_index_contract_v2` pins schema/tokenizer/application-id.
  - Determinism: fixed page size, journal off, application id `SIG2`, sorted inserts, one transaction — byte-identical on identical inputs (tested).
- **`exports/src/exports/data/search_aliases.toml`** — the K3 §4.4 alias registry (data, not code): 11 seeded rows — case-sensitive acronyms (ICE, CBP, DHS, FBI, HSI, RTCC, LEARN) and case-insensitive technical terms (ALPR, LPR, ANPR, CCTV, the last four with `technology:` targets). `load_search_aliases` validates fail-closed (required fields, URL form, `reviewed_on` ISO date, no duplicate keys). A case-sensitive key is deliberately absent from `exact_names` — normalized lookup must never present a word-match as the acronym.
- **`exports/src/exports/release.py`** — additive wiring: every release build emits the three v2 artifact sets beside the unchanged v1 `search_index` files, all integrity-listed in `sig.release-integrity/1`. The v1 descriptor's `search_index_version` pin is untouched (still names the v1 artifact it ships); the v2 files carry their own /2 descriptors. New kwargs: `technology_vocab_path`, `search_aliases_path`, `jurisdiction_registry_path`.
- **`tests/exports/test_search_index_v2.py`** — 25 tests: descriptor contract, marked derived names, FTS name/place/source matching, claim_ref exact lookup (UUID + free-form ids), byte-determinism + sorted insertion, fail-closed subject gate, alias-registry validation, all doc types, jurisdiction exact-name resolution with homonym parents, case-sensitive acronym exclusion from `exact_names`, trigrams + prefix FTS, drift/contract/release-pin refusals, release-build integration (integrity-listed, verifier passes against manifest digests).

## Scope posture (recorded)

- **Dual-emit interim:** v1 `search_index.sqlite`/`.json` artifacts are emitted unchanged for serving continuity; v2 files land additively (`search_index_v2.*`, `claim_ref.sqlite`, `releases/<pub>/search/*`). SRCH-03 (P36.38) wires v2 serving; the v1 emit is retired when the serving flip lands — consistent with K3 §5.4 (older promoted releases keep their v1 route; a format change bumps `search_index_version` at the serving flip).
- **Gazetteer interim:** catalog places come from the bound `jurisdiction_registry` when supplied, else `jurisdiction_key_map` — the Natural Earth layers stay HG-03 gated (never fetched here). `places_source` is recorded in the descriptor inputs.
- **K2 entities "as present":** `web/entities.json` is read when the K2 export seam emits it; absent today, the descriptor scope records the absence.
